object.description: Leave conflict markers in DOC's object file and open the repository in the Project Explorer; rest the pointer on DOC. Then, with the repository open and DOC readable, break the file again and press F5; restore it and press F5 again. Expected: DOC and PARENT are both listed; DOC's entry says it failed to load and its tooltip gives the file with its line and '(unresolved merge conflict?)'; the status bar says 1 failed to load; PARENT has no load error. F5 shows the new load error, and after the file is restored F5 clears it.
